patch.value: Merge-safety docs follow-up: clarify verify scope + pin pm-cli 2026.7.22 (Greptile P1/P2)

Follow-up to pm-beads#42. Greptile review (raised on the fleet fan-out) flagged two items on the merge-reconcile docs: P1 the pinned @unbrained/pm-cli devDep resolved to 2026.7.21 which lacks pm merge reconcile, so npm ci gives an unknown-command; P2 pm history --verify checks a single stream while a merge can affect several. Fix: bump the devDep floor to 2026.7.22 and refresh the lockfile so the documented command exists in the repo toolchain; reword the verify step to lead with whole-tracker pm validate and note that pm merge reconcile lists each affected stream, with pm history --verify as a per-item spot check.

README leads post-reconcile verification with whole-tracker pm validate and clarifies affected-stream scope; @unbrained/pm-cli devDep floor is 2026.7.22 with a refreshed lockfile; CI green; PR bot-reviewed.
